sn56.36:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso yam imasmiṃ Jambudīpe tiṇakhaṭṭhasākhāpalāsam taṃ chetvā ekajjhaṃ saṃhareyya ||
sn56.36:1.3: sūlaṃ karitvā ye mahāsamudde mahantakā pāṇā te mahantakesu sūlesu āvuneyya || ye mahāsamudde majjhimakā pāṇā te majjhimakesu sūlesu āvuneyya || || Ye mahāsamudde sukhumakā pāṇā te sukhumakesu sūlesu āvuneyya || ||
sn56.36:1.4: Apariyādiṇṇā ca bhikkhave mahāsammudde oḷārikā pāṇā assu ||
sn56.36:2.1: atha te imasmiṃ Jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsam parikkhayaṃ pariyādānam gaccheyya ||
sn56.36:2.2: ato bahutarā kho bhikkhave mahāsamudde sukhumakā pāṇā ye na sukarā sūlesu āvunituṃ ||
sn56.36:2.6: evam mahantasmā kho bhikkhave apāyasmā parimutto diṭṭhisampanno puggalo yo Idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtam pajānāti || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtam pajānāti || || 4.
sn56.36:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo
